overview: Flow/error control: window size, sequence numbers, link utilization, minimum bits for sequence numbers.
coreConcept: Efficiency = window x transmission time / (transmission time + 2 x propagation delay), max 1.
hinglishExplanation: Sender window itni frames bhej sakta hai bina ack ke. Pipe bharne ke liye window >= 1 + 2a jahan a = Tp/Tt. GBN me sequence numbers >= W+1; SR me >= 2W (sender window + receiver window).
formalDefinition: Efficiency = window x transmission time / (transmission time + 2 x propagation delay), max 1.
importantProperties: Utilization U = min(1, W/(1+2a)), a = Tp/Tt.
GBN: send window N, receive window 1, seq numbers N+1.
SR: seq numbers >= Ws + Wr (= 2W), max window 2^(k-1).
GBN retransmits from lost frame onwards; SR only lost frame.
